accept: A 65-second verification and a slow locked command leave ping and tools/list responsive within 500ms on an otherwise idle local machine; independent-root requests also complete before the long work ends.

With a progress token, send monotonic progress at least every 5 seconds while pending; a client using timeout=60000 and resetTimeoutOnProgress=true receives the final result after 65 seconds. Without a token, send no progress notification.

Offload the whole run_locked path including baseline capture and final report construction, and standalone report verification. Preserve final content and isError for success, violation, command failure and incomplete checks.

While a job owns a canonical repository root, reject competing same-root tools promptly as busy, including undo, activate, amend, draft, report and another run; release ownership on completion or worker failure. Resolve aliases and nested roots to the shared Git worktree identity.

Client cancellation or timeout does not silently retry, undo, kill a worker mid-probe, or release its repository guard: allow the job to finish and retain its record for report recovery. Graceful disconnect waits for active work; abrupt process death recovery is outside this lock.

Worker startup/error/exit failures return an error without claiming verified; stdout remains MCP-only; Node startup flags including --liftoff-only are inherited; flight recorder retains one completed entry per tool call.
Existing probe process-group timeout, cleanup, output hashing, seal refusal, task-baseline retry and verdict tests stay green; npm test and npm run eval pass.
No activation before the user says yes; Kimi audit before a commit, explicit user commit instruction still required; never push. Help-book sandboxing is a separate future Vibe Check and lock.
